name: MushMap
tagline: A mushroom foraging journal and weekly heat map for Washington and Oregon.
description: Log a find from a photo: the time and GPS location come from the photo's EXIF data.
A weekly likelihood map per species, built from research-grade iNaturalist sightings, USDA host-tree maps, elevation, and this year's rain and temperature against past finds.
A trail finder that ranks OpenStreetMap trails by the chance of a mushroom along them and how accessible the trail is.
Installable as an app and works offline.

name: IsThisNormal
tagline: Is a Supreme Court ruling, executive action or contentious law "normal"?
description: Measures each ruling, executive action and contentious law since 2000 against the precedent, statute text and public data that existed when it happened.
Free daily ingestion of public records (Federal Register, Congress, Supreme Court opinions) into a citation graph.
AI analysis scored against versioned rubrics, which only runs on approval and within a set budget.
A static site with no cookies or analytics.
